1. (Currently amended) A composite stiffener, comprising: first, second and third members formed from laminated composite tape, the first and second members defining a web and flange member being joined to the flanges and extending generally transverse to the web, the first, second and third composite members intersecting to form a void; a filler disposed in and substantially filling the void, wherein the filler comprises __a reinforcing material that is distinct from the composite tape material of the first, second and third members__; at least one layer of composite fabric on each of the members in the area of the filler; and, a layer of adhesive surrounding the filler and joining the filler to the composite fabric, wherein __the adhesive is applied as a distinct layer separate from any resin matrix of the composite tape or composite fabric__.

2. (Currently amended) The composite stiffener of claim 1, wherein the first and second members include radius areas between the web and each of the flanges, and the fabric layer covers the radius areas, and __the adhesive layer is distinct from any adhesive resin contained within the reinforcing fiber bundle of the filler__.

5. (Currently amended) The composite stiffener of claim 1, wherein the layer of adhesive and the at least one layer of composite fabric extend beyond the radius areas, and __the adhesive is applied as a structural adhesive layer that is physically distinct from the composite tape and composite fabric materials__.

6. (Currently amended) The composite stiffener of claim 1, wherein the at least one layer of composite fabric of the composite members are offset relative to each other, and __the offset is created by intentional placement of the fabric layers rather than by wrinkles or deformation in the layered strips__.

7. (Currently amended) A composite stiffener, comprising: a pair of composite channels joined together, each of the channels including a web, flanges extending from the web, and radius areas between the web and each of the flanges; a base extending transverse to the web and joined to each of the flanges, the radius areas of the channels and the base forming at least one radius filler zone; a reinforcing member filling the radius filler zone, wherein __the reinforcing member comprises a material that is distinct from the laminated composite tape material of the channels and base__; a layer of composite fabric covering the radius areas of the channels and the base; and, a layer of adhesive surrounding the filler and joining the filler to the composite fabric layer, wherein __the adhesive is applied as a distinct structural adhesive layer separate from any resin matrix of the channels, base, or composite fabric__.

12. (Currently amended) The composite stiffener of claim 7, wherein the composite fabric layer includes __at least three composite patches respectively positioned on each of the channels and the base, wherein the patches are applied as discrete layers of fabric material__.

13. (Currently amended) The composite stiffener of claim 7, wherein the layer of adhesive includes a sheet of structural adhesive wrapped around the filler, and __the structural adhesive sheet is applied as a distinct layer that is separate from any resin matrix within the composite channels or base__.

15. (Currently amended) The composite stiffener of claim 7, wherein __the channels are formed from unidirectional laminated composite tape plies and the base is formed from unidirectional laminated composite tape plies, and the reinforcing member in the radius filler zone comprises a material selected from the group consisting of a formed unidirectional composite tape, a composite laminate, a hybrid tape-fabric member, and a titanium member__.

25. (Currently amended) A composite stiffener for aircraft applications, comprising: an I-section structure formed of laminated composite tape having a web and flanges on each end of the web, the structure including a cap and a base, including radius areas between the web and the flanges and between the web and the cap and base being joined to the first set of the flanges and the base being joined to the second set of flanges, the cap and the base each intersecting the web in the radius areas to define a radius filler zone; a layer of composite fabric covering the radius areas in the radius filler zone; a reinforcing filler in the radius filler zone, wherein __the reinforcing filler comprises a material that is distinct from the laminated composite tape material of the I-section structure__; and a layer of structural adhesive surrounding and joining the filler to the composite fabric in the radius filler zone, wherein __the structural adhesive is applied as a distinct layer that is separate from any resin matrix of the I-section structure or composite fabric__.
